math.name: Combined G
math.expr: hypot('CG Accel Lateral', 'CG Accel Longitudinal')
math.description: Total horizontal acceleration — the radius of the friction circle.

math.name: Corner Radius
math.expr: gate(min(('Ground Speed' [m/s]) ^ 2 / (abs('CG Accel Lateral') * 9.81), 2000), abs('CG Accel Lateral') > 0.3)
math.description: Radius of the path the car is on (speed² ÷ lateral acceleration), shown while cornering (> 0.3 G). Smaller = tighter line; compare laps to see who opened the corner up.

math.name: Steering Rate
math.expr: derivative('Steering Angle')
math.description: How fast the driver turns the wheel; spikes show corrections.

math.name: Throttle Brake Overlap
math.expr: choose('Throttle Pos' > 5 and 'Brake Pos' > 5, 1, 0)
math.description: 1 while throttle and brake are both applied.

math.name: Coasting
math.expr: choose('Throttle Pos' < 2 and 'Brake Pos' < 2 and 'Ground Speed' > 30, 1, 0)
math.description: 1 while neither pedal is used (lost time!).

math.name: Full Throttle
math.expr: choose('Throttle Pos' > 98, 1, 0)
math.description: 1 at full throttle. Mean over a lap = full-throttle fraction.

math.name: Braking Time Lap
math.expr: integrate_lap(choose('Brake Pos' > 5, 1, 0))
math.description: Accumulated braking time within the lap.

math.name: Brake Steer Combination
math.expr: 100 * sqrt(clamp(('Brake Pos' - 2) / 98, 0, 1) * clamp((abs('Steering Angle') - 5) / 85, 0, 1))
math.description: How much braking and steering are combined at once (trail braking): the geometric mean of brake (2–100 %) and steering lock (5–90°). 0 = either input alone, 100 = full brake at 90° lock. Edit the 85/90° scale to suit the car.

math.name: Brake Steer Combination Lap
math.expr: integrate_lap('Brake Steer Combination' / 100)
math.description: Accumulated brake–steer combining in the lap, in seconds of 'full brake at full lock'. Use the lap's last value (Trend: stat = last) to compare how much each lap trail-brakes.

math.name: Trail Braking Time Lap
math.expr: integrate_lap(choose('Brake Pos' > 5 and abs('Steering Angle') > 10, 1, 0))
math.description: Time in the lap spent braking (> 5 %) with steering lock on (> 10°).

math.name: Damper Velocity FL
math.expr: derivative('Damper Travel FL')
math.description: Damper speed (FL). Positive = bump, negative = rebound.

math.name: Damper Velocity FR
math.expr: derivative('Damper Travel FR')
math.description: Damper speed (FR). Positive = bump, negative = rebound.

math.name: Damper Velocity RL
math.expr: derivative('Damper Travel RL')
math.description: Damper speed (RL). Positive = bump, negative = rebound.

math.name: Damper Velocity RR
math.expr: derivative('Damper Travel RR')
math.description: Damper speed (RR). Positive = bump, negative = rebound.

math.name: Tyre Temp Avg FL
math.expr: ('Tire Temp Inner FL' + 'Tire Temp Middle FL' + 'Tire Temp Outer FL') / 3
math.description: Average surface temperature across the FL tread.

math.name: Tyre Temp Avg FR
math.expr: ('Tire Temp Inner FR' + 'Tire Temp Middle FR' + 'Tire Temp Outer FR') / 3
math.description: Average surface temperature across the FR tread.

math.name: Tyre Temp Avg RL
math.expr: ('Tire Temp Inner RL' + 'Tire Temp Middle RL' + 'Tire Temp Outer RL') / 3
math.description: Average surface temperature across the RL tread.

math.name: Tyre Temp Avg RR
math.expr: ('Tire Temp Inner RR' + 'Tire Temp Middle RR' + 'Tire Temp Outer RR') / 3
math.description: Average surface temperature across the RR tread.

math.name: Tyre Temp Spread FL
math.expr: 'Tire Temp Inner FL' - 'Tire Temp Outer FL'
math.description: Inner minus outer temperature (FL) — a camber indicator.

math.name: Tyre Temp Spread FR
math.expr: 'Tire Temp Inner FR' - 'Tire Temp Outer FR'
math.description: Inner minus outer temperature (FR) — a camber indicator.

math.name: Tyre Temp Spread RL
math.expr: 'Tire Temp Inner RL' - 'Tire Temp Outer RL'
math.description: Inner minus outer temperature (RL) — a camber indicator.

math.name: Tyre Temp Spread RR
math.expr: 'Tire Temp Inner RR' - 'Tire Temp Outer RR'
math.description: Inner minus outer temperature (RR) — a camber indicator.

math.name: Tyre Wear Rate FL
math.expr: clamp(smooth('Ground Speed' [m/s] * 'ndSlip FL' * max('Tire Load FL', 0), 0.2) / 5000, 0, 100)
math.description: How fast the FL tyre is wearing right now, 0–100 (speed × normalised slip × load). Colour a track map by it to see where the rubber goes: lock-ups, wheelspin and slides light up.

math.name: Tyre Wear Rate FR
math.expr: clamp(smooth('Ground Speed' [m/s] * 'ndSlip FR' * max('Tire Load FR', 0), 0.2) / 5000, 0, 100)
math.description: How fast the FR tyre is wearing right now, 0–100 (speed × normalised slip × load). Colour a track map by it to see where the rubber goes: lock-ups, wheelspin and slides light up.

math.name: Tyre Wear Rate RL
math.expr: clamp(smooth('Ground Speed' [m/s] * 'ndSlip RL' * max('Tire Load RL', 0), 0.2) / 5000, 0, 100)
math.description: How fast the RL tyre is wearing right now, 0–100 (speed × normalised slip × load). Colour a track map by it to see where the rubber goes: lock-ups, wheelspin and slides light up.

math.name: Tyre Wear Rate RR
math.expr: clamp(smooth('Ground Speed' [m/s] * 'ndSlip RR' * max('Tire Load RR', 0), 0.2) / 5000, 0, 100)
math.description: How fast the RR tyre is wearing right now, 0–100 (speed × normalised slip × load). Colour a track map by it to see where the rubber goes: lock-ups, wheelspin and slides light up.

math.name: Tyre Wear Lap FL
math.expr: integrate_lap('Ground Speed' [m/s] * 'ndSlip FL' * max('Tire Load FL', 0) / 5000)
math.description: FL tyre wear accumulated in the lap: metres of full sliding at 5 kN. Proportional to the grip the game takes off (Tire Rubber Grip); use the lap's last value in a Lap Trend to compare laps, stints and drivers.

math.name: Tyre Wear Lap FR
math.expr: integrate_lap('Ground Speed' [m/s] * 'ndSlip FR' * max('Tire Load FR', 0) / 5000)
math.description: FR tyre wear accumulated in the lap: metres of full sliding at 5 kN. Proportional to the grip the game takes off (Tire Rubber Grip); use the lap's last value in a Lap Trend to compare laps, stints and drivers.

math.name: Tyre Wear Lap RL
math.expr: integrate_lap('Ground Speed' [m/s] * 'ndSlip RL' * max('Tire Load RL', 0) / 5000)
math.description: RL tyre wear accumulated in the lap: metres of full sliding at 5 kN. Proportional to the grip the game takes off (Tire Rubber Grip); use the lap's last value in a Lap Trend to compare laps, stints and drivers.

math.name: Tyre Wear Lap RR
math.expr: integrate_lap('Ground Speed' [m/s] * 'ndSlip RR' * max('Tire Load RR', 0) / 5000)
math.description: RR tyre wear accumulated in the lap: metres of full sliding at 5 kN. Proportional to the grip the game takes off (Tire Rubber Grip); use the lap's last value in a Lap Trend to compare laps, stints and drivers.

math.name: Tyre Wear Lock-up FL
math.expr: clamp(smooth('Ground Speed' [m/s] * 'ndSlip FL' * max('Tire Load FL', 0) * choose('Tire Slip Ratio FL' < 0, sqr('Tire Slip Ratio FL' / 100) / max(sqr('Tire Slip Ratio FL' / 100) + sqr(rad('Tire Slip Angle FL')), 0.000000001), 0), 0.2) / 5000, 0, 100)
math.description: Part of the FL wear rate from lock-ups / braking slip (negative slip ratio), 0–100.

math.name: Tyre Wear Wheelspin FL
math.expr: clamp(smooth('Ground Speed' [m/s] * 'ndSlip FL' * max('Tire Load FL', 0) * choose('Tire Slip Ratio FL' > 0, sqr('Tire Slip Ratio FL' / 100) / max(sqr('Tire Slip Ratio FL' / 100) + sqr(rad('Tire Slip Angle FL')), 0.000000001), 0), 0.2) / 5000, 0, 100)
math.description: Part of the FL wear rate from wheelspin / traction slip (positive slip ratio), 0–100.

math.name: Tyre Wear Slide FL
math.expr: clamp(smooth('Ground Speed' [m/s] * 'ndSlip FL' * max('Tire Load FL', 0) * (1 - sqr('Tire Slip Ratio FL' / 100) / max(sqr('Tire Slip Ratio FL' / 100) + sqr(rad('Tire Slip Angle FL')), 0.000000001)), 0.2) / 5000, 0, 100)
math.description: Part of the FL wear rate from cornering slide (slip angle), 0–100.

math.name: Tyre Wear Lock-up FR
math.expr: clamp(smooth('Ground Speed' [m/s] * 'ndSlip FR' * max('Tire Load FR', 0) * choose('Tire Slip Ratio FR' < 0, sqr('Tire Slip Ratio FR' / 100) / max(sqr('Tire Slip Ratio FR' / 100) + sqr(rad('Tire Slip Angle FR')), 0.000000001), 0), 0.2) / 5000, 0, 100)
math.description: Part of the FR wear rate from lock-ups / braking slip (negative slip ratio), 0–100.

math.name: Tyre Wear Wheelspin FR
math.expr: clamp(smooth('Ground Speed' [m/s] * 'ndSlip FR' * max('Tire Load FR', 0) * choose('Tire Slip Ratio FR' > 0, sqr('Tire Slip Ratio FR' / 100) / max(sqr('Tire Slip Ratio FR' / 100) + sqr(rad('Tire Slip Angle FR')), 0.000000001), 0), 0.2) / 5000, 0, 100)
math.description: Part of the FR wear rate from wheelspin / traction slip (positive slip ratio), 0–100.

math.name: Tyre Wear Slide FR
math.expr: clamp(smooth('Ground Speed' [m/s] * 'ndSlip FR' * max('Tire Load FR', 0) * (1 - sqr('Tire Slip Ratio FR' / 100) / max(sqr('Tire Slip Ratio FR' / 100) + sqr(rad('Tire Slip Angle FR')), 0.000000001)), 0.2) / 5000, 0, 100)
math.description: Part of the FR wear rate from cornering slide (slip angle), 0–100.

math.name: Tyre Wear Lock-up RL
math.expr: clamp(smooth('Ground Speed' [m/s] * 'ndSlip RL' * max('Tire Load RL', 0) * choose('Tire Slip Ratio RL' < 0, sqr('Tire Slip Ratio RL' / 100) / max(sqr('Tire Slip Ratio RL' / 100) + sqr(rad('Tire Slip Angle RL')), 0.000000001), 0), 0.2) / 5000, 0, 100)
math.description: Part of the RL wear rate from lock-ups / braking slip (negative slip ratio), 0–100.

math.name: Tyre Wear Wheelspin RL
math.expr: clamp(smooth('Ground Speed' [m/s] * 'ndSlip RL' * max('Tire Load RL', 0) * choose('Tire Slip Ratio RL' > 0, sqr('Tire Slip Ratio RL' / 100) / max(sqr('Tire Slip Ratio RL' / 100) + sqr(rad('Tire Slip Angle RL')), 0.000000001), 0), 0.2) / 5000, 0, 100)
math.description: Part of the RL wear rate from wheelspin / traction slip (positive slip ratio), 0–100.

math.name: Tyre Wear Slide RL
math.expr: clamp(smooth('Ground Speed' [m/s] * 'ndSlip RL' * max('Tire Load RL', 0) * (1 - sqr('Tire Slip Ratio RL' / 100) / max(sqr('Tire Slip Ratio RL' / 100) + sqr(rad('Tire Slip Angle RL')), 0.000000001)), 0.2) / 5000, 0, 100)
math.description: Part of the RL wear rate from cornering slide (slip angle), 0–100.

math.name: Tyre Wear Lock-up RR
math.expr: clamp(smooth('Ground Speed' [m/s] * 'ndSlip RR' * max('Tire Load RR', 0) * choose('Tire Slip Ratio RR' < 0, sqr('Tire Slip Ratio RR' / 100) / max(sqr('Tire Slip Ratio RR' / 100) + sqr(rad('Tire Slip Angle RR')), 0.000000001), 0), 0.2) / 5000, 0, 100)
math.description: Part of the RR wear rate from lock-ups / braking slip (negative slip ratio), 0–100.

math.name: Tyre Wear Wheelspin RR
math.expr: clamp(smooth('Ground Speed' [m/s] * 'ndSlip RR' * max('Tire Load RR', 0) * choose('Tire Slip Ratio RR' > 0, sqr('Tire Slip Ratio RR' / 100) / max(sqr('Tire Slip Ratio RR' / 100) + sqr(rad('Tire Slip Angle RR')), 0.000000001), 0), 0.2) / 5000, 0, 100)
math.description: Part of the RR wear rate from wheelspin / traction slip (positive slip ratio), 0–100.

math.name: Tyre Wear Slide RR
math.expr: clamp(smooth('Ground Speed' [m/s] * 'ndSlip RR' * max('Tire Load RR', 0) * (1 - sqr('Tire Slip Ratio RR' / 100) / max(sqr('Tire Slip Ratio RR' / 100) + sqr(rad('Tire Slip Angle RR')), 0.000000001)), 0.2) / 5000, 0, 100)
math.description: Part of the RR wear rate from cornering slide (slip angle), 0–100.

math.name: Tyre Wear Lock-up Avg
math.expr: ('Tyre Wear Lock-up FL' + 'Tyre Wear Lock-up FR' + 'Tyre Wear Lock-up RL' + 'Tyre Wear Lock-up RR') / 4
math.description: Lock-up part of the wear rate, averaged over the four tyres.

math.name: Tyre Wear Wheelspin Avg
math.expr: ('Tyre Wear Wheelspin FL' + 'Tyre Wear Wheelspin FR' + 'Tyre Wear Wheelspin RL' + 'Tyre Wear Wheelspin RR') / 4
math.description: Wheelspin part of the wear rate, averaged over the four tyres.

math.name: Tyre Wear Slide Avg
math.expr: ('Tyre Wear Slide FL' + 'Tyre Wear Slide FR' + 'Tyre Wear Slide RL' + 'Tyre Wear Slide RR') / 4
math.description: Cornering-slide part of the wear rate, averaged over the four tyres.

math.name: Tyre Wear Lock-up Front
math.expr: ('Tyre Wear Lock-up FL' + 'Tyre Wear Lock-up FR') / 2
math.description: Lock-up part of the wear rate, front axle (FL and FR averaged), 0–100.

math.name: Tyre Wear Wheelspin Front
math.expr: ('Tyre Wear Wheelspin FL' + 'Tyre Wear Wheelspin FR') / 2
math.description: Wheelspin part of the wear rate, front axle (FL and FR averaged), 0–100.

math.name: Tyre Wear Slide Front
math.expr: ('Tyre Wear Slide FL' + 'Tyre Wear Slide FR') / 2
math.description: Cornering-slide part of the wear rate, front axle (FL and FR averaged), 0–100.

math.name: Tyre Wear Left-Right Front
math.expr: 'Tyre Wear Rate FL' - 'Tyre Wear Rate FR'
math.description: Front axle wear-rate balance: FL minus FR. Above 0 = the left tyre is wearing faster there, below 0 = the right.

math.name: Tyre Wear Lock-up Rear
math.expr: ('Tyre Wear Lock-up RL' + 'Tyre Wear Lock-up RR') / 2
math.description: Lock-up part of the wear rate, rear axle (RL and RR averaged), 0–100.

math.name: Tyre Wear Wheelspin Rear
math.expr: ('Tyre Wear Wheelspin RL' + 'Tyre Wear Wheelspin RR') / 2
math.description: Wheelspin part of the wear rate, rear axle (RL and RR averaged), 0–100.

math.name: Tyre Wear Slide Rear
math.expr: ('Tyre Wear Slide RL' + 'Tyre Wear Slide RR') / 2
math.description: Cornering-slide part of the wear rate, rear axle (RL and RR averaged), 0–100.

math.name: Tyre Wear Left-Right Rear
math.expr: 'Tyre Wear Rate RL' - 'Tyre Wear Rate RR'
math.description: Rear axle wear-rate balance: RL minus RR. Above 0 = the left tyre is wearing faster there, below 0 = the right.

math.name: Tyre Wear Front-Rear
math.expr: ('Tyre Wear Rate FL' + 'Tyre Wear Rate FR') / 2 - ('Tyre Wear Rate RL' + 'Tyre Wear Rate RR') / 2
math.description: Front minus rear wear rate (each axle averaged). Above 0 = the fronts are wearing faster there, below 0 = the rears.

math.name: Tyre Wear Left-Right
math.expr: ('Tyre Wear Rate FL' + 'Tyre Wear Rate RL') / 2 - ('Tyre Wear Rate FR' + 'Tyre Wear Rate RR') / 2
math.description: Left minus right wear rate (each side averaged). Above 0 = the left tyres are wearing faster there (right-hand corners load the left), below 0 = the right.

math.name: Tyre Wear Front Share
math.expr: 100 * ('Tyre Wear Lap FL' + 'Tyre Wear Lap FR') / max('Tyre Wear Lap FL' + 'Tyre Wear Lap FR' + 'Tyre Wear Lap RL' + 'Tyre Wear Lap RR', 1)
math.description: The fronts' share of the wear so far in the lap (50 = even). Its end-of-lap value in a Lap Trend is the front / rear balance per lap.

math.name: Tyre Wear Left Share
math.expr: 100 * ('Tyre Wear Lap FL' + 'Tyre Wear Lap RL') / max('Tyre Wear Lap FL' + 'Tyre Wear Lap FR' + 'Tyre Wear Lap RL' + 'Tyre Wear Lap RR', 1)
math.description: The left tyres' share of the wear so far in the lap (50 = even). Its end-of-lap value in a Lap Trend is the left / right balance per lap.

math.name: Tyre Wear Rate Avg
math.expr: ('Tyre Wear Rate FL' + 'Tyre Wear Rate FR' + 'Tyre Wear Rate RL' + 'Tyre Wear Rate RR') / 4
math.description: Wear rate averaged over the four tyres, 0–100. Colour a track map by its difference to the reference to see where a lap uses more rubber.

math.name: Tyre Wear Lap Avg
math.expr: ('Tyre Wear Lap FL' + 'Tyre Wear Lap FR' + 'Tyre Wear Lap RL' + 'Tyre Wear Lap RR') / 4
math.description: Wear accumulated in the lap, averaged over the four tyres. Its end-of-lap value in a Lap Trend is the stint's tyre-wear figure per lap.

math.name: Rake
math.expr: 'Ride Height Rear' - 'Ride Height Front'
math.description: Rear minus front ride height.

math.name: Total Downforce
math.expr: 'Aero Downforce F' + 'Aero Downforce R'
math.description: Front + rear downforce.

math.name: Aero Balance
math.expr: choose('Aero Downforce F' + 'Aero Downforce R' > 500, 100 * 'Aero Downforce F' / ('Aero Downforce F' + 'Aero Downforce R'), invalid())
math.description: Front share of total downforce (invalid at low speed).

math.name: Aero Efficiency
math.expr: choose('Aero Drag' > 100, ('Aero Downforce F' + 'Aero Downforce R') / 'Aero Drag', invalid())
math.description: Downforce / drag (L/D).

math.name: Front Load Share
math.expr: 100 * ('Tire Load FL' + 'Tire Load FR') / max('Tire Load FL' + 'Tire Load FR' + 'Tire Load RL' + 'Tire Load RR', 1)
math.description: Share of vertical load on the front axle.

math.name: Lateral Load Transfer
math.expr: 100 * (('Tire Load FR' + 'Tire Load RR') - ('Tire Load FL' + 'Tire Load RL')) / max('Tire Load FL' + 'Tire Load FR' + 'Tire Load RL' + 'Tire Load RR', 1)
math.description: Right-minus-left load as a share of total (positive = loaded on the right).

math.name: Rear Wheelspin
math.expr: max('Tire Slip Ratio RL', 'Tire Slip Ratio RR')
math.description: Largest rear slip ratio — traction loss on exits.

math.name: Front Lockup
math.expr: min('Tire Slip Ratio FL', 'Tire Slip Ratio FR')
math.description: Most negative front slip ratio — lock-ups under braking.

math.name: Brake Temp Front Avg
math.expr: ('Brake Temp FL' + 'Brake Temp FR') / 2
math.description: Mean front disc temperature.

math.name: Brake Temp Rear Avg
math.expr: ('Brake Temp RL' + 'Brake Temp RR') / 2
math.description: Mean rear disc temperature.

math.name: Lap Fuel Used
math.expr: stat_max('Fuel Level') - 'Fuel Level'
math.description: Fuel burned since the start of the lap.

math.name: Speed Smoothed
math.expr: smooth('Ground Speed', 0.3)
math.description: Ground speed with a 0.3 s moving average.
